fact: The Assembly's intercommission report of 20 August 2026 on bill n°25/2026 states that State data must be stored on national territory with regulated exceptions, creates the Autorité nationale de cybersécurité attached to the Presidency (articles 21-23) and provides sanctions for breaches of security obligations.
title: Rapport Projet de loi n°25/2026 – Protection des infrastructures d'informations critiques et sécurité numérique
